_comment: Param rows written into dist/gamedata/regulation.bin by scripts/build-gamedata.ps1 (tools/regulation = sbwriter, Smithbox's writer, from the pinned 1.03.3 regulation.bin). UI-3: the Battle Royale card in the expedition list. Row 9 of NightBossMenuParam is a hidden placeholder (its name text is empty); it is REPLACED with row 100's values and our texts (FMG ids 131152 name / 131153 description, gamedata/fmg-entries.json), always unlocked, sorted after row 100 (sort 300). A new row id (e.g. 101) does not show in the list (in-game test 2026-11-02). 'expect' = the vanilla values the build checks before writing; 'values' = the fields written (all 20, so the row does not depend on its old content).
